summary: The routine you cannot imagine losing may be the same routine that kept you from finding out how much has changed.
body: The routine you cannot imagine losing may be the same routine that kept you from finding out how much has changed. When Uranus conjuncts Chiron, a cancellation, move, technical failure, sudden opening, or abrupt change can knock out the workaround that made an old fear easier to manage. That is the bargain hidden inside predictability: it protected you from being hurt again, but it also gave you very little reason to test what you can handle now. Replace the support you still need. Do not automatically rebuild every rule that grew around the version of you who needed more protection.
